children: Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant cut output on the second of its four reactors by 150 megawatts (MW) on Sunday due to a mechanical equipment malfunction, plant operator MVM said in a statement on its website.
Engineers were working on fixing the issue, it said. Reactor 4 was powered down on Friday due to scheduled maintenance, it said earlier.
